authority: Operator instruction to execute the Autonomous Coding Agent Completion Handoff exactly
rule: A boundary names behavior JoeCoder does not claim or certify. It may not be treated as passed, waived, or inferred. Expanding a boundary requires new implementation and executable proof.

limitations.boundary: Deterministic evidence gates independently reject model self-certification; a separate model reviewer persona is not a required or claimed trust boundary.
Memory is project-scoped, freshness-aware, evidence-linked, and non-authoritative; cryptographic source-version identities across externally moved projects are not claimed.
Automated startup, session, packaging, and restart checks run; a separately provisioned clean Windows user-account qualification remains external.
Unknown, skipped, limited, or integrity-only checks disqualify full verified completion; a general-purpose time-expiring waiver issuance workflow is not exposed.
Eligible provider fallback and bounded repair exist; provider health does not survive a full service restart and failure-fingerprint routing is not claimed.
Supported project-specific gates run independently; unavailable stack-specific security, architecture, performance, or packaging tools remain named limitations rather than passes.
Pinned npm installs are admitted and reproducible; offline-cache guarantees and equivalent installers for every non-Node ecosystem are not claimed.
Browser, responsive, interaction, screenshot, and accessibility tools are available for loopback web projects; they are not universally applicable to every desktop, mobile, audio, or embedded stack.
Acceptance cannot widen silently; semantic detection of every possible weakened project test or policy is not claimed.
Affected tests and original failure evidence are rerun; full mutation testing and optimal regression selection for every language are not claimed.
A.C.D.Q. questions and answers are not a mandatory execution gate; automatic work relies on objective framing, ambiguity detection, and stop-for-user rules.
Explicit non-goals are not a required persisted field on every job.
Commands are bounded, shell-free, path-jailed, and process-tracked, but Windows AppContainer, restricted-token, and measured network isolation are not claimed.
Secrets remain environment-backed and excluded from UI evidence; Windows Credential Manager integration and complete historical-log redaction certification are not claimed.
Durable records and evidence are project-scoped; OS-account isolation and exhaustive cross-version leakage certification are not claimed.
Pinned npm dependency admission and signed release artifacts are enforced; cryptographic admission bundles for every external model, skill, plugin, and MCP server are not supported or claimed.
Scoped files are snapshotted and restored, but a complete isolated version-tree workspace is not used for every execution.
Each replacement is atomic and multi-file failures restore prior writes; the filesystem cannot expose the whole multi-file set as one atomic rename.
Committed events provide plain-language progress and proof links; complete manual accessibility certification and elimination of all technical diagnostic detail are not claimed.
The durable Agent Job is authoritative for automatic work; legacy Work Order records do not implement every field in the ratified Work Order schema.
